look_here_first: Ask whether the holly is deciduous. Possumhaw drops its leaves and often leaves dense red-orange drupes exposed along pale gray twigs in winter.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: alternate simple leaves, elliptic to obovate/spatulate

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: thin-textured leaves with shallow crenate to crenate-serrate margins

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small axillary white flowers; plants primarily dioecious

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: female plants bear red to orange-red drupes clustered along twigs

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruit commonly persists after leaf drop

lookalikes.differences: Within local hollies, deciduous winter-bare fruiting twigs are the fastest field separator.
